purpose: Protected Routine Recurrence boundary selector payload.

check_constraints.name: ck_routine_recurrence_boundary_state_boundary_payload
check_constraints.expression_contract: ((boundary_kind='date' AND date_value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(date_value) AND local_value IS NULL AND zone_id IS NULL AND instant_value IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL) OR (boundary_kind='floating_local' AND local_value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(local_value) AND date_value IS NULL AND zone_id IS NULL AND instant_value IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL) OR (boundary_kind='named_zone_local' AND local_value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(local_value) AND zone_id IS NOT NULL AND date_value IS NULL AND instant_value IS NULL AND (resolved_at IS NULL OR isfinite(resolved_at))) OR (boundary_kind='absolute_instant' AND instant_value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(instant_value) AND date_value IS NULL AND local_value IS NULL AND zone_id IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL))

check_constraints.name: ck_routine_recurrence_boundary_state_inclusive_role
check_constraints.expression_contract: ((boundary_role='pattern_anchor' AND inclusive IS NULL) OR (boundary_role IN ('effective_from','effective_until') AND inclusive IS NOT NULL))

triggers.name: trg_routine_recurrence_boundary_state_iana_timezone
triggers.reason: CP6-M05 database-local enforcement for IANA timezone validity.

triggers.name: ctrg_routine_recurrence_boundary_state_recurrence
triggers.reason: Requires a valid live recurrence aggregate, or no recurrence selectors/payload after explicit retirement.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Protected Routine recurrence boundary selector payload; owning recurrence envelope/history survive retirement.
state_history.current_binding: Bound through the owning routine.recurrence MaterialState.
state_history.chronology: Boundary values are payload, not the retained currentness history.
state_history.immutability_policy: No ordinary runtime table-level UPDATE surface.

lifecycle.retention: Retain only while the owning Routine recurrence MaterialState is live or policy requires this protected selector payload.
lifecycle.redaction: Delete boundary rows in the canonical retirement transaction after durable PREPARED suppression evidence exists.
lifecycle.retirement_tombstone: No payload-local tombstone; dante.material_state_retirement preserves the owning MaterialStateRef retirement continuity.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime has no DELETE; owner/recovery lifecycle paths remove payload only as part of validated retirement/reconciliation.
